title: The Message from Work
focus: 核对重要信息、表达感受、说明下一步
story:
A few weeks after I move in, I arrive at work and find a message on my screen.

“Team meeting. Ten o’clock. Please come to the meeting room.”

There is no list of topics.

Our manager, Wei, is already there. Usually, he has coffee. Today, he has a glass of water and several sheets of paper.

The meeting is in Chinese. I understand every word. For once, language is not the problem.

The company is closing our team. There is not enough work for everyone. Our last working day will be at the end of next month. We will receive the details in writing.

Someone asks about pay. Someone else asks about moving to another team. Wei answers slowly. There are no other positions for us at the moment.

I look at the small mark on the table beside my hand. I have seen it in many meetings. I have never looked at it this closely.

“Do you have any questions?” Wei asks.

I shake my head.

Back at my desk, I open the same file three times. I cannot remember what I want to change.

The woman at the next desk takes a green apple out of her bag. She usually cuts it in two and puts half on my desk.

“Do you want some?” she asks.

“No, thanks.”

She puts the whole apple back. A minute later I say, “Actually, yes.”

She gets the apple out again. We stand by the sink and eat it there. She wants to know who will answer the shop's calls after we leave. I want to know if we still have our Thursday lunch. Neither of us knows.

Wei comes in with his empty glass. “Can I get to the tap?”

We move apart. I nearly ask him about Thursday. Instead I hold the door for him on his way out. He has to carry all his papers with one hand.

At my desk the calendar is still open. There is a meeting on it for the week after our last day. I put my hand on the mouse to delete it. It's someone else's meeting. I leave it there.

At lunch, I send Rui a message.

“My team is closing.”

He calls a minute later.

“Are you okay?”

“I don’t know.”

“When do you finish?”

“At the end of next month.”

“Do you have the details?”

“They’re sending them.”

“Read them carefully. We can talk tonight.”

I say yes, then ask what time.

When I get home, Maya is cutting vegetables. There is room for both of us in the kitchen now.

“How was work?” she asks.

I put my bag on the floor.

“Not good.”

She puts down the knife.

“What happened?”

I know the words in Chinese. In English, I can only find small pieces.

“My team is closing. Next month. I need a new job.”

“Oh, Andy. I’m sorry.”

I sit down.

“Did you know this was coming?”

“No. We had less work. But I didn’t know.”

“Do you want to talk, or do you want some food first?”

“Food, please.”

She takes another plate from the cupboard. We eat rice and vegetables. For a while, we talk about nothing important. She tells me the shop downstairs has new opening hours. I tell her the lift makes a strange sound.

After dinner, I open my banking app. I have some savings. I can pay my part of the rent for several months, but I need to spend less.

“I can still pay the rent,” I tell Maya.

“Okay. Thank you for telling me.”

“I’ll look for work this weekend.”

“What kind of work?”

“Software. Maybe an international company.”

I almost laugh after saying it.

“My English isn’t good enough.”

“For every job?” she asks.

“I don’t know.”

“Then look at a few. Find out what they need.”

She does not promise to find me a job. She does not say everything will be easy. She gets her laptop and begins her own work.

At eight, Rui calls. I take the call in my room, under the light of my new lamp.

Before we finish, I write three things on a piece of paper: read the company letter, update my CV, choose three jobs to look at.

The list does not solve the problem. But tomorrow morning, I know where to start.

phrases.en: At the end of next month.

phrases.zh: 承认信息或决定还不明确

phrases.en: I’ll look at a few jobs.

practice.grammar: 用 will / I’ll 表示此时作出的下一步安排：I’ll read the letter. I’ll update my CV。为明天说两件可做的小事。
practice.pronunciation: 长时间表达分组：at the END / of NEXT MONTH。先单独说时间，再放进完整句。

questions.a: At the end of next month.

questions.q: What does Andy want before talking more?
What three things does Andy write down?
questions.a: Read the company letter, update his CV, and choose three jobs to look at.

roleplay.context: 你向朋友说明一个工作变化。可以虚构，不需要提供私人情况。

turns.cue: 用两句说明你的团队将关闭，你需要找工作。
说两个具体步骤，允许停顿和简单句。

practice.transfer: 换成课程被取消：说明课程何时结束、你还不知道什么、准备怎样找替代课程。
practice.retell: 用约一分钟讲这一天。包括发生的事、Andy 的感受、朋友做了什么、他的三个下一步。

translations.6-1: 搬进来几个星期后，一天我到了公司，看到屏幕上有条消息。
translations.6-8: 今天，他面前放着一杯水和几张纸。
translations.6-11: 这一次，问题终于不在语言上。
translations.6-12: 公司要解散我们的团队。
translations.6-13: 工作量不足以支撑所有人。
translations.6-14: 我们的最后一个工作日是下个月底。
translations.6-15: 具体安排会以书面形式发给我们。
translations.6-17: 另一个人问能不能调去其他团队。
translations.6-19: 目前没有其他岗位可以安置我们。
translations.6-20: 我看着手边桌面上的一个小印子。
translations.6-21: 开过那么多次会，我都见过它。
translations.6-22: 却从没这么仔细地看过。
translations.6-26: 回到工位，我把同一个文件打开了三遍。
translations.6-27: 我想不起自己要改什么。
translations.6-28: 邻桌的女同事从包里掏出一个青苹果。
translations.6-29: 平时她会切成两半，在我桌上放半个。
translations.6-32: 她把整个苹果放了回去。
translations.6-33: 过了一会儿，我说：“其实，我还是想吃。”
translations.6-35: 我们站在水池旁，把苹果分着吃了。
translations.6-36: 她想知道我们走了以后，店里打来的电话由谁接。
translations.6-37: 我想知道我们星期四还会不会一起吃午饭。
translations.6-41: 我们各自往旁边让了让。
translations.6-42: 我差点开口问他星期四还一起吃饭吗。
translations.6-43: 最后我什么也没问，只在他出去时替他扶着门。
translations.6-44: 他得用一只手拿着所有的文件。
translations.6-45: 回到桌旁，屏幕上的日历还开着。
translations.6-46: 日历里还有个会，排在我们离职后的那一周。
translations.6-47: 我把手放在鼠标上，想把它删掉。
translations.6-48: 可那是别人发起的会议。
translations.6-50: 午饭时，我给Rui发了条消息。
translations.6-61: 我答应了，然后问了具体时间。
translations.6-63: 现在厨房里已经能容得下我们两个人了。
translations.6-69: 用中文，我知道该怎么说。
translations.6-70: 可用英语，我只能挤出一些零碎的话。
translations.6-83: 她从橱柜里又拿出一个盘子。
translations.6-85: 有一会儿，我们聊的都是些无关紧要的事。
translations.6-86: 她说楼下的商店改了营业时间。
translations.6-87: 我说电梯会发出奇怪的声音。
translations.6-88: 晚饭后，我打开手机银行。
translations.6-90: 我那份房租还能付几个月，但得省着点花。
translations.6-98: 说完这句话，我自己差点笑出来。
translations.6-104: 她没有承诺帮我找到工作。
translations.6-105: 也没说一切都会很容易。
translations.6-106: 她拿来电脑，开始忙自己的工作。
translations.6-108: 我在自己房间里，坐在新台灯的灯光下接了电话。
translations.6-109: 结束通话前，我在纸上写了三件事：读公司的通知、更新简历、挑三个职位看看。
translations.6-110: 这份清单解决不了问题。
translations.6-111: 但明天早上，我知道该从哪里开始了。
